desc:
CRISPY GRAHAM SQUARES: Enjoy crispy, delicious graham squares, ideal for adults and kids

GRAHAM CRACKER TASTE: Every bowl tastes like the irresistible pairing of graham crackers and milk from childhood

WHOLE GRAIN GOODNESS: Each serving provides 14g whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily) and a good source of calcium, with 12 vitamins and minerals

BREAKFAST ADDITION OR SNACK: Serve this cereal as part of a quick breakfast, or add to cereal bars recipes, homemade trail mix, and other on the go snacks

CONTAINS: One 16.7 oz Large Size cereal box of General Mills Golden Grahams Cereal
features:
Features

Classic Graham Cracker Flavor: Each bite delivers the warm, nostalgic taste of honey-kissed graham crackers.
Made with Whole Grain Wheat: Includes whole grain as the first ingredient, supporting a more balanced breakfast.
Light & Crispy Texture: Golden squares stay crunchy in milk and offer a satisfying bite.
No High-Fructose Corn Syrup: Sweetened naturally with sugar and brown sugar syrup for a cleaner label.
Fortified with Essential Vitamins & Minerals: Includes calcium, iron, vitamin D, B vitamins, and more.
Family-Sized Box: Offers multiple servings—ideal for families or cereal lovers who enjoy daily bowls.
Versatile Use: Great as a breakfast cereal, dry snack, or an ingredient in cereal bars and dessert recipes.

Benefits

A Comforting Start to the Day: Delivers a delicious, graham cracker taste that brings back childhood memories.
Nutrient Support in Every Bowl: Fortified to help meet daily nutritional needs with key vitamins and minerals.
Kid-Approved & Parent-Trusted: Loved by all ages for its taste, while parents appreciate its whole grain content.
Snack-Friendly Beyond Breakfast: Perfect for lunchboxes, snack mixes, or late-night cravings—no milk required.
Balanced Sweetness: Offers just the right amount of sweetness without being overpowering.
Energy-Boosting: A good source of quick energy thanks to its mix of whole grains and natural sugars.
ingredients: Whole Grain Wheat, Corn Meal, Sugar, Brown Sugar Syrup, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Dextrose, Baking Soda, Salt, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Rosemary Extract. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Tricalcium Phosphate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
